fossil_elements: Large, weathered bone fragments (vertebrae, ribs) partially exposed on a sandy slope
Distinctive ripple marks in the sandstone indicating ancient water flow
Small, delicate plant impressions (ferns, horsetails) fossilized in surrounding shale
Patches of sparse, dry scrub and desert grass clinging to eroded slopes
Geological tools (rock hammer, trowel) casually placed near the find
ground_palette: Dark grey-green (for fossilized bone and shale)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded, tactile; very high visual density; clear educational silhouettes for fossil elements and geological features. Focus on realism for the fossil itself, but with a stylized presentation for the scene.

visual_logic.composition: A dynamic, low-angle shot emphasizing the scale of the badlands. A partially exposed fossil bone dominates the mid-ground, leading the eye towards subtle geological features in the background. The foreground shows cracked earth with faint hints of tools. Centered at the bottom or top is the game title 'Dino Fossil Hunt!' in bold, chisel-cut stone-like 3D letters with a metallic sheen, subtly embedded into the landscape.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, cracked earth with exposed sandstone and shale layers, hinting at ongoing erosion.
visual_logic.lighting: Harsh, direct midday sun with sharp shadows to emphasize the rugged terrain and texture of the exposed fossils, making the title 'pop' with a metallic glint.
